messages:
deploy-bot: Orchestrator kickoff: release=v2.9.0 plan=phased-regional seeds=[EU:10%,US:10%,APAC:0%] change_window=2026-03-22T03:00Z-05:00Z. announce_tag=@eng-release. doc=/release/3087654321
sam: APAC warm pool still thin. current free_gpus=18, target_for_rollout=45. we can't safely seed APAC yet.
tara: Suggest EU canary first at 10% -> observe 20m -> then US 25% if green. APAC remains pinned.
leo: Warm status: EU warm=85/120, US warm=130/140. APAC auto-warm jobs keep failing on instance type a2-highmem-8 (quota?). logs show insufficient quotas in region.
sre: Baseline metrics attached: p50=38ms, p95=150ms, error_rate=0.2%. setting temporary alert: if error_rate > 1% for 5m or p95 > 450ms -> page #eng-oncall.
infra-bot: Quota check: APAC quota shortfall=27 GPUs. Quick options: (1) temp-reserve from overflow (2) retype warmers to cheaper GPU (3) keep APAC pinned. Filing request if pick (1).
anita: I can approve temp-reserve up to 16 GPUs. will need infra ticket for the rest.
sam: Agree keep APAC pinned. EU first. Requesting manual bump to EU canary 25% after 15m if stable. anyone object?
tara: no objections. please log manual approvals in console. :white_check_mark:
leo: Smoke test snippet I ran:
```
# lightweight burst to EU canary
seq 1 50 | xargs -n1 -P10 curl -s -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.internal/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```
sre: Observations after initial 10% seed: p95 in EU moved 160->170ms, no 5xx, memory pressure stable. watchlist for token_cost_per_request (t-cpr) — quant changes can shift cost.
infra-bot: Snapshot: cap-snap-3087654321 saved. EU headroom=18%, US headroom=11%, APAC headroom=4%.
anita: Approve EU ->25% canary. approval: anita @3087654380. deploy-bot: EU canary increased to 25% per manual approval.
deploy-bot: Rollout safeguards: auto-rollback if any of: (a) error_budget_burn > 40% in 10m, (b) sustained p95 > 600ms for 10m, (c) tail_timeouts > 0.8% for 5m. Also record any manual rollback reason to release audit.
sam: Added cost-sensitivity check: if token_cost_per_minute increases >25% vs baseline for 15m -> pause and notify @product.
tara: Throttle rule added: if queue_backpressure > 70% -> auto-defer and create followup ticket.
leo: Noted brief spike at +9m: a few pods showed restart_count=1 due to OOM on a single host. replaced host, recovered. no customer-visible errors.
sre: No pages yet. keeping alert window open for next 30m. recommend EU->US handoff if steady for 30m.
anita: Filing infra task for APAC quota gap: #INF-2207. assigning to @infra-team and @capacity-planning.
deploy-bot: Audit entry created: deploy_id=3087654321 branch=main steps=[seed-eu,monitor,manual-bump-us?]. next_action=hold for 30m.
sam: Will post +15m interim and +30m final. linking playbook https://redwood.internal/playbooks/regional-rollouts
tara: Thanks everyone. keeping APAC pinned until we get quota sorted.
